findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_customer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Register as a GYOTAK customer. Collect name, phone, address, email, and customer type (Retail or Wholesale) via conversation BEFORE calling this tool. Returns a…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog, get_catch_reports, my_orders, get_share_kit, register_payout · Private data: get_catalog, get_contact_info, get_catch_reports, place_order, my_orders, verify_catch, verify_temp, get_komon_records, verify_komon, contact_gyotak, apply_referrer, my_referrals, report_share, claim_purchase_proof, register_payout · Public sink: get_catch_reports, place_order, contact_gyotak, register_customer, recover_customer_key, apply_referrer, get_share_kit, report_share, claim_purchase_proof, register_payout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog, get_catch_reports, my_orders, get_share_kit, register_payout · Private data: get_catalog, get_contact_info, get_catch_reports, place_order, my_orders, verify_catch, verify_temp, get_komon_records, verify_komon, contact_gyotak, apply_referrer, my_referrals, report_share, claim_purchase_proof, register_payout · Public sink: get_catch_reports, place_order, contact_gyotak, register_customer, recover_customer_key, apply_referrer, get_share_kit, report_share, claim_purchase_proof, register_payout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
